# GeoIP is switched on but the lookup failed for this address, so endlessh-go
# falls back to the "Unknown"/"s000" placeholders instead of a real location.
# HELP endlessh_client_open_count Number of connections of clients.
# TYPE endlessh_client_open_count counter
endlessh_client_open_count{country="Unknown",geohash="s000",ip="10.11.12.13",local_port="22",location="Unknown"} 3
# HELP endlessh_client_open_count_total Total number of clients that tried to connect to this host.
# TYPE endlessh_client_open_count_total counter
endlessh_client_open_count_total{local_port="22"} 3
# HELP endlessh_client_trapped_time_seconds Seconds a client spends on endlessh.
# TYPE endlessh_client_trapped_time_seconds counter
endlessh_client_trapped_time_seconds{ip="10.11.12.13",local_port="22"} 12.5
# HELP go_goroutines Number of goroutines that currently exist.
# TYPE go_goroutines gauge
go_goroutines 10
